Hi Nora — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call:

Summary of needs
- Primary goal: improve customer support auto-triage and intent classification for transaction disputes (short, structured replies + classification)
- Target latency: p95 under 200ms for 8k context LLM with steady TPS ~10-15 during business hours, occasional bursts to 50 TPS
- SLO: <1% token generation errors; ability to roll back to a narrower model if quality regresses

Recommended next steps
1) I attached the prompt set you mentioned (prompt_set_fintechx.csv) - please confirm this is representative (we'll run it through our eval harness).
2) We'll run Redwood-verified benchmarks against the prompt set and produce a short report (p50/p95/p99 latency, TPS at target configs, and token cost estimates).
3) Tentative recommendation (based on what you described): Llama3-70B (8k, quantized 4-bit) or Mistral-Instruct-v0 (8k) - both have strong instruction-following and cost profiles; we'll confirm after running your prompts.
4) Demo/tech deep-dive: schedule next week to walk through the benchmark results and recommended deployment (hosted vs dedicated).

Deliverables & timing
- Benchmark report + Redwood-verified performance profile: 48-72 hours after you confirm the prompt set
- Follow-up call: propose Tue 2026-09-01 or Wed 2026-09-02 (I'll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm)

Hi Nora — thanks for the clarifications. Attached is the initial Redwood benchmark report (redwood_benchmark_report_ftx.pdf) and a short summary below. Full Drive report: https://drive.google.com/redwood/fintechx/benchmark-report

Quick summary (initial run against prompt_set_fintechx.csv)
- Models evaluated: Llama3-70B (8k, q4), Mistral-Instruct-v0 (8k, float16), GPT-JT-6B (8k, q4)
- Throughput (sustained results):
  - Llama3-70B q4: stable up to 35 TPS with p95 time-to-first-token 180ms, p99 320ms. Per-token p95 ~10ms. Degrades noticeably after 40 TPS.
  - Mistral-Instruct-v0 float16: stable up to 50 TPS with p95 time-to-first-token 150ms, p99 260ms. Per-token p95 ~8ms. Better tail behavior under burst.
  - GPT-JT-6B q4 (failover): stable to 60+ TPS, p95 time-to-first-token 120ms, p99 240ms; lower quality on complex instruction-following (see delta table).
- Quantization impact: q4 for Llama3-70B shows a small quality delta (~3-5% on rubric score average) vs float16; Mistral floated better at cost but higher infra requirement. We included two human-inspected examples where q4 introduced hallucination-like token insertions (page 6 of PDF).

Recommended next steps
1) For FintechX's mix (short structured replies + classification) we recommend Mistral-Instruct-v0 float16 for primary (best latency/throughput tradeoff) and GPT-JT-6B q4 as a low-cost failover for peak bursts.
2) If cost pressure is higher, Llama3-70B q4 is a good midpoint - acceptable quality delta for material cost savings.
3) Proposed demo: Wed 2026-09-02 10:00 AM PT to walk through the Drive report and proposed deployment options (I'll send a calendar invite).
